items.title: Patanjali Foods Q4 Results: Profit jumps 46% to Rs 524 crore despite margin pressure
items.description: Patanjali Foods reported a strong rise in quarterly and annual earnings, driven by robust growth in its edible oils and FMCG businesses. While revenue expanded across key segments, higher raw material, packaging and freight costs weighed on margins. The company also continued expanding its oil palm cultivation and export footprint.
